title: EP_annotator: Annotating enhancer-promoter interactions using Hi-C and CUT&Tag data
description: EP_annotator is a bioinformatics tool for annotating enhancer–promoter (EP) interactions by integrating Hi-C chromatin interaction data with CUT&Tag histone modification signals (H3K27ac). It implements a six-step workflow that takes raw HiCUT allValidPairs files and CUT&Tag BED files as input and produces annotated EP interaction maps, supporting the mouse genome (mm10).
